name: Button
notFor: Navigation to another page — that is an anchor, and a button breaks middle-click, cmd-click, copy-link-address and the browser's history model
A destination that should be bookmarkable
A toggle with two persistent states — that is Switch

anatomy.note: type defaults to the native submit inside a form; pass type explicitly.
loading only. aria-hidden; the label below carries the announcement.
aria-hidden in both slots. An icon that carries meaning belongs in the label.
Always rendered. Never empty — an icon-only button still needs a name.

variant.meaning: how much visual weight it carries

tone.meaning: what happens if you press it
tone.note: Renamed from 'default' in 4.0 so that every tone axis in the system shares one vocabulary.

loading.note: Stays focusable — losing focus mid-interaction is worse than a brief inert control — and blocks the click via aria-disabled plus a guard, not the disabled attribute.

loadingLabel.note: Visually hidden, announced while loading. Localised by the consumer.

iconStart.angular: marker attribute [bhIconStart] on a child element — the directive has no template, so there is nothing to project into

iconEnd.angular: marker attribute [bhIconEnd] on a child element

children.note: Required. There is no icon-only variant, because an icon-only button with no accessible name is the single most common a11y defect in an ERP toolbar.
children.angular: the content of the consumer’s own <button> element

keyboard.Tab: Moves focus in. A loading button stays in the tab order; a disabled one does not.

attributes.aria-disabled: true while loading — not the disabled attribute, which would remove it from the tab order

aria.labelling: From the label slot. Required; there is no aria-label prop, because a prop invites an icon-only button.
aria.focus: Visible ring from border.focus at 3:1 against both surface.base and surface.raised. Never removed on :focus-visible.
aria.announcements: loadingLabel is announced when loading becomes true; the label itself does not change.

content.label: Sentence case, imperative, no trailing period. 'Save changes', not 'Save Changes' or 'Submit'.

variant=\"danger\".reason: variant conflated visual weight with consequence

tone=\"default\".reason: 'default' was Button-only; every other tone axis in the system starts at 'neutral'
